strings.adc_saturated: ADC saturated at full scale. Check the bridge excitation, the gain, and that the bridge sits inside the common mode window (AGND+1.2 V to AVDD-1.3 V).
strings.calibrate.help: Derive the scale from a known mass
strings.calibrate_how: Run 'loadcell tare' with the scale empty first, then place a known mass and run this. The unit is whatever you use here.
strings.calibrate_more_samples: For about %.2f%%, run 'loadcell tare 100' and 'loadcell calibrate %g 100'
strings.calibrate_precision: Scale good to +/-%.2f%% (%.1f counts of uncertainty)
strings.calibrated: Calibrated: %.1f counts per unit (%.1f counts for %.4f units)
strings.channel_b_note: Channel B has a fixed gain of 32, and on most load cell breakouts INB+/INB- go nowhere -- the reading will be drift, not an error.
strings.clock_stretched: A clock pulse was held high for %lu us against the T3 limit of %d us; the reading was discarded. If it repeats, something is stalling the CPU -- usually a flash write.
strings.dout_config_failed: Configuring GPIO %d as the DOUT input failed
strings.dout_never_low: DOUT (GPIO %d) never went low, so no conversion became ready. Check the wiring, the part's power, and that PD_SCK (GPIO %d) is not stuck high.
strings.dout_stuck_low: DOUT (GPIO %d) did not return high after the clock burst: either the clock is not reaching the part -- check PD_SCK is on GPIO %d -- or DOUT is shorted to ground.
strings.gain.help: Show or set the gain (32 is channel B only)
strings.gain_32_switches_channel: Gain 32 exists only on channel B, so this also switches channel.
strings.gain_choice_32: 32  channel B (26 pulses) -- B has no other gain
strings.gain_choices: Gain must be 32, 64 or 128, and each one fixes the channel too:
strings.gpio_absent: GPIO %d does not exist on this chip
strings.group.help: HX711 24-bit load cell ADC, bit-banged on two pins (no bus)
strings.info_common_mode: Common mode window: AGND+1.2 V to AVDD-1.3 V -- outside it a bridge reads confidently and wrongly; check it with a meter
strings.info_input_range: Input range: +/-0.5 x AVDD/gain -- at gain %d that is +/-%.1f mV at AVDD 5.0 V, +/-%.1f mV at 3.3 V
strings.info_part: HX711 24-bit ADC, no control bus and no registers
strings.info_settings_header: Settings (Table 3), selected by the number of clock pulses:
strings.init.help: Claim the pins and prove the part responds
strings.init_gain_missing: Give the gain, e.g. 'loadcell init 5 6 gain 128'
strings.init_scale_missing: Give the scale factor, e.g. 'loadcell init 10 3 scale 1074.3'
strings.input.help: Show or set the input channel
strings.long_wait: Averaging %d samples at %.1f SPS will take about %.0f s.
strings.mass_invalid: The known mass must be a non-zero number
strings.need_two_samples: 'loadcell tare' and 'loadcell calibrate' need at least two samples. Re-run as 'loadcell tare 10' and 'loadcell calibrate %g 10'.
strings.next_step_calibrate: Run 'loadcell tare' with no load, then 'loadcell calibrate <known mass>'
strings.next_step_weigh: Run 'loadcell tare' with no load, then 'loadcell weight'
strings.no_scale: No scale factor. Run 'loadcell tare' then 'loadcell calibrate <known mass>', or set one with 'loadcell scale <counts_per_unit>'.
strings.no_tare: No tare yet; run 'loadcell tare' with the cell empty before weighing
strings.not_calibrated: Not calibrated. Run 'loadcell tare' with no load, then 'loadcell calibrate <known mass>'.

not_initialized.text: HX711 not initialized. Run 'loadcell init <dout> <sck>' first.

strings.pins_distinct: DOUT and PD_SCK must be different pins; both were given as GPIO %d
strings.pins_numeric: Both pins must be GPIO numbers
strings.power.help: Power the part down via PD_SCK, or wake it
strings.power_down_note: PD_SCK (GPIO %d) held high; the part powers down after %d us, and the bridge with it if the internal regulator feeds it
strings.power_up_note: PD_SCK released; the part reset and the configured setting was re-applied

powered_down.text: HX711 is powered down. Run 'loadcell power on' first.

strings.rate_no_strap: Rate %.1f SPS -- neither strap. Check XI (pin 14) is grounded; a stalled console task also does this
strings.rate_strap_high: Rate %.1f SPS -- RATE strap high (80 SPS nominal), period %.1f ms
strings.rate_strap_low: Rate %.1f SPS -- RATE strap low (10 SPS nominal), period %.0f ms
strings.read.help: Averaged raw ADC counts, in units if calibrated
strings.read_raw: Raw %10.1f counts  (%d samples, spread %ld, %.4f%% of full scale)
strings.released: HX711 released; both pins are back in their reset state
strings.reset_note: A reset loses the tare and scale. Give the factor back with 'loadcell init <dout> <sck> scale <counts_per_unit>'; the tare has to be measured again.
strings.responding: HX711 responding on DOUT GPIO %d, PD_SCK GPIO %d
strings.scale.help: Show or set the scale factor without measuring one
strings.scale_is_measured: Scale %.1f counts per unit (measured this session)
strings.scale_is_supplied: Scale %.1f counts per unit (supplied, not measured this session)
strings.scale_not_a_number: Scale factor must be a number
strings.scale_set: Scale set to %.1f counts per unit (supplied, not measured)
strings.scale_set_failed: Setting the scale factor to %g failed
strings.scale_supplied: Scale %.1f counts per unit (supplied, not measured)
strings.scale_supplied_note: This factor belongs to the gain now in force, and a gain or channel change drops it. To survive 'loadcell init', give it as 'loadcell init <dout> <sck> scale %.17g'.
strings.scale_zero: Scale factor must not be zero
strings.sck_config_failed: Configuring GPIO %d as the PD_SCK output failed
strings.sck_unusable: GPIO %d cannot be used for PD_SCK: %s
strings.status.help: Show the pins, setting, measured rate and calibration state
strings.status_bursts_discarded: ; %lu burst(s) exceeded it and were discarded
strings.status_dout_low: DOUT GPIO %d, now low (a result is waiting)
strings.status_dout_powered_down: DOUT GPIO %d, level not meaningful while powered down
strings.status_rate_powered_down: Rate not measured while powered down
strings.status_worst_high: Worst PD_SCK high phase %lu us (T3 limit %d us)
strings.stuck_reading: All %d readings were identical (0x%06lX), so DOUT (GPIO %d) is not carrying real data. Check it is on the HX711's DOUT pin and not shorted.
strings.tare.help: Capture the zero offset with no load
strings.tare_drift: Moved %.1f counts from the tare, within the +/-%.1f the two averages are known to. Is the mass on the cell, and was 'loadcell tare' run empty? Or average harder: 'loadcell tare 100' then 'loadcell calibrate %g 100'.
strings.tare_missing: A scale factor is set but no tare has been taken, so every weight would be the bridge's own offset reported as load. Run 'loadcell tare' with the cell empty.
strings.tare_scale_dropped: Tare and scale dropped; run 'loadcell tare' and 'loadcell calibrate' again.
strings.tare_scale_dropped_supplied: Tare and scale dropped: a supplied factor belongs to the gain it was measured at. Give both with 'loadcell init <dout> <sck> gain <n> scale <counts_per_unit>'.
strings.tare_set: Tare set to %ld counts (%d samples, spread %ld, mean known to +/-%.1f)
strings.usage_init_pins: <dout> is the GPIO on DOUT (an input here), <sck> the one on PD_SCK (an output). Gain defaults to 128 on channel A.
strings.weight: Weight %12.4f units  (+/-%.4f over %d samples, spread %.4f, %.1f raw counts)
strings.weight.help: Report the load in calibrated units
strings.weight_one_sample: Weight %12.4f units  (1 sample, no noise estimate, %.1f raw counts)
strings.weight_precision_note: The +/- on a weight is repeatability, not the accuracy of a supplied factor
